Mophie recently launched four new external battery packs designed for iPhones. They slip easily into a pocket, come in two colour options, feature built-in charging cables, and offer either 5,000mAh or 10,000mAh capacities. While they aren't the smallest power banks on the market, the price point is attractive, making them well worth picking up.

Mophie's new PowerStation Plus power banks are split into Standard and Signature lines, with each line offering both 5,000mAh and 10,000mAh capacity options.

The Standard and Signature versions are the same size, though the Signature version features a more premium build and comes with a braided charging cable.

All four models include a built-in USB-C cable for convenience, but the cable cannot be stowed away. The cable is located on the side of the power bank and can be pulled out when needed.

The three lower-tier PowerStation Plus models come with one built-in charging cable, while the Signature 10K version comes with two braided charging cables. Combined with an additional USB-C port, up to three devices can be charged simultaneously.

As mentioned at the outset, these power banks are by no means the smallest options on the market, but they're also not as bulky as many other brands. This allows them to slip easily into a pocket without being too conspicuous, so there's no need to carry them in a backpack. The power banks also feature LED battery indicator lights.

The USB-C port on every Mophie PowerStation Plus supports 20W power output, and the same port can also be used to charge the power bank itself. The 5K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro approximately once, while the 10K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro twice. Given recent incidents of external battery packs catching fire, Mophie has also specifically designed these products to comply with airline carry-on luggage regulations.

Mophie PowerStation Plus is available on Amazon, with prices starting from US$29.95 for the range and going up to US$59.95.

  • PowerStation Plus 5K Standard Series — US$29.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Standard Series — US$39.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 5K Signature Series — US$39.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Signature Series — US$59.95 on Amazon
